name: @projexlight/sdk-geo
summary: Address canonicalization + geocoding + reverse-geocoding for ProjexCloud: takes free-form input ('123 Main, Suite 4, Cambridge MA') → canonical address row + lat/lng. Aliases let multiple inputs collapse to one canonical row; merge events propagate when canonicalization rules tighten. Foundation for field-service routing + sales territory assignment + tax-jurisdiction lookup.

endpoints.description: Normalize a free-form address to a canonical row; idempotent.
Address → lat/lng via the configured provider.
Manually register an alias for a canonical address.
Merge two canonical addresses (when canonicalization tightens).

events.name: geo.address.canonicalized.v1
events.description: New canonical address row created or reused.

events.name: geo.address.geocoded.v1
events.description: Lat/lng resolved for an address (cached for the configured TTL).

events.name: geo.address.alias.added.v1
events.description: New input string aliased to an existing canonical row.

events.name: geo.address.merged.v1
events.description: Two canonical rows merged; downstream consumers update references.

models.description: Per-canonical-address row: line1, line2, city, region, postal_code, country, lat, lng.
Per-(input, canonical) row — many aliases collapse to one canonical address.
Per-merge row: from_address, to_address, persona, reason, occurred_at.

hooks.name: addAlias
hooks.description: Manually map an input string to an existing canonical row.

hooks.name: mergeAddresses
hooks.description: Merge two canonical rows (canonicalization rule tightened).

scenarios.title: Customer signup → address canonicalized
scenarios.when_to_use: Webform passes a free-form address; canonicalize returns / creates the canonical row + the customer record stores the address_id (not raw text).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns existing address_id on dedupe-hit; creates + returns new id otherwise. Emits .canonicalized.v1 only on net-new.

scenarios.title: Field dispatch geocodes addresses for route optimization
scenarios.when_to_use: sdk-dispatch needs lat/lng for each stop; cached results return immediately, fresh ones hit the configured provider.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Lat/lng + accuracy. Emits .geocoded.v1 (lww) on cache miss. Provider cost passes through pricing.

scenarios.title: Tech mobile app reverse-geocodes their GPS position
scenarios.when_to_use: Mobile app needs to know which address the tech is at for proof-of-presence on a work order.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Nearest canonical address returned (within tolerance). If none, prompts the tech to confirm the address manually.

scenarios.title: Customer-success rep adds an alias
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer wrote 'Bldg 4, MIT' and the canonicalizer didn't match — rep manually aliases it to the canonical MIT address.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Alias row written; future canonicalize calls with that input return MIT immediately. Emits .alias.added.v1.

scenarios.title: Canonicalization tightened → merge two duplicates
scenarios.when_to_use: Two rows for the same physical address (different abbreviations); merge collapses them + downstream consumers update their refs.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Rows merged; emits .merged.v1. Downstream consumers (sdk-crm, sdk-dispatch) re-point references.

compliance_posture.notes: Address data is PII; lookups audited. Geocoder provider keys vault-wrapped via sdk-secrets. Merge events retain the from/to ref so a regulator can reconstruct the pre-merge state if needed.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per geocode (cache hits free; provider cost passes)
